TECHNICAL_DESCRIPTION: Option C is classified as ENGINEERING_RISK_ONLY. It is NOT formally governance-rejected unless an authoritative decision states that.
Single MILP solve combining all 4 stages into scalar objective: c_total = w1*c1 + w2*c2 + w3*c3 + w4*c4.
Penalty weights must be derived from bounded numerical ranges of individual objective terms and solver tolerances.
Example weights (10^12, 10^8, 10^4, 1) are ILLUSTRATIVE_ONLY and are PROVISIONAL / NOT AUTHORIZED FOR PRODUCTION.
Large weight scale separation severely degrades MILP constraint matrix condition number, risking numerical instability.
High risk: lower-stage objective accumulation can pollute higher-stage boundaries if scale separation is insufficient.
High verification burden: requires extensive numerical sensitivity audits across all operational regimes.
